patterns.desc: CORE money formula: transfer is credit-card revenue minus outcomes
the bank transfer is the raw transfer amount — no ÷1.18 for exempt stores, whose prices carry no VAT (must stay in step with totalForInvoice in routes/hyp.js)
commission is charged on the FINAL items price charged — productDiscounts must NOT be added back here (owner decision 2026-08-04), while reimbursed coupons, Shoofi compensations and drive-in stay in
card revenue is the price actually charged, not the pre-discount list price
drive-in is INSIDE the commission base and is read with this fallback chain — older orders carry only the nested driveInPricing form

shippingPrice is the COURIER's money (effectiveDeliveryFee) and is OUTSIDE the store commission base — if this moves into routes/payments/admin.js's revenue build, the base and every report on it is wrong
order.total is built from orderPrice + shippingPrice + driveIn − coupon − coins, so it is never a commission base — reports must sum orderPrice + driveIn instead

CORE invariant 7: the store is billed a coupon's nominal storeDiscount whenever it is not customer-specific and not full_discount — the gate is blind to discountType, so a delivery coupon lands here too

CORE invariant 7: a percentage-type coupon bills the store a percentage of the ITEMS subtotal even when its discountType is 'delivery' — couponDeliverySplit deliberately diverges and takes the share off order.shippingPrice instead (owner ruling 2026-08-12)
deleting a report releases its carry-over compensations back to pending, so the regenerated report re-bills them
store→Shoofi compensations (compensationFor 'shoofi') are an OUTCOME inside totalOutcomes — never credited back, never a coupon
every term of totalOutcomes must be a BILLING_COMPONENT, or the dashboard's reconciliation delta lies
the live overview runs the store report ENGINE over the range — it must never re-derive settlement math
delivery-fee population is the settlement one (delivered, not delivery-only), not the dashboard's completedAt

CORE invariant 3 (combo note): a line's originalPrice adds the extras portion undiscounted — for a combo that is surcharges + nested extras, and the customer-facing combo 'savings' is never part of it, so it never becomes a productDiscount
CORE invariant 3: productDiscount is derived from the order's own originalOrderPrice vs charged price — nothing else (not a combo's display savings) feeds it

known-status OPEN: /payments/admin/drivers builds its explicit startDate/endDate boundaries with NO utcOffset, so they are server-TZ dependent while bookDelivery.created always carries Israel's offset — prefer a period keyword over client dates, and do not harmonise this without asking
